responsibility: Defines the check_consts module interface and shared const-checking context, exposing the per-body ConstCx state and helpers that classify const items, const-stability, and allowed unstable const-fn features for use by the const-checking passes.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the top-level `transform/mod.rs`, which only exposes the transform submodules, this `mod.rs` is the entry point for one specific transform area: const-checking. Its code defines the shared `ConstCx` and const-stability/feature-gate classification helpers used by checking passes, so its boundary is legality analysis of const bodies rather than general transform-module wiring. Unlike `const_eval/mod.rs` or `interpret/mod.rs`, it does not execute constants; it determines what operations are permitted in const, static, and const-fn contexts.
